name: Last Login
description: Displays the last login time of the current logged-in user in a block.
project_description:
This module is used to display the last login time of current logged in user.

 This module stores the last login time in a session variable and pass this variable to

Last login time Block. It is a lightweight module which do not create an extra table

in a database. It is easy to install & use. 

 To display the last login time of current logged in user, You need to do the following. 

 Installation: 
 Drupal 7 
 
 Download the module and place in sites/all/modules directory. 
 Enable the module in admin/modules. 
 Now goto admin/structure/block. 
 Follow only one of the both ways mentioned below:-
 
 Enable the Last login time block and assign a specific region. 
 OR 
 You can directly print session variable ("user_last_login") in your template file.
 
 
 
 You need to logout and login again to see the last login time. 
 
 Drupal 8 
 
 Download the module and place into the modules directory. 
 Enable the module in admin/modules. 
 Now goto admin/structure/block. 
 Click on "Place block" button and assign a particular region to "Last Login Time" block. 
 You need to logout and login again to see the last login time.
